title: The Apocrypha, King James Version
author: Translators of the Authorized Version (1611)
license: public domain (outside the UK; Crown letters patent apply in the UK only)
notes: The 14 books of the Apocrypha as printed in the 1611 KJV (Tobit ... 2 Esdras, Prayer of Manasses), 5,720 verses, same format as kjv.md. Kept separate because WCF I.3 holds them no part of the canon; included because 2 Maccabees 12:43-46 is the Roman proof-text for prayers for the dead (answered by Calvin, Institutes III.5.8). Not canonical for this house (WCF 1.3): reference only, never quoted as Scripture.

title: The Holy Bible, King James Version (Old and New Testaments)

Standard 1769 Oxford text from the eBible.org/CrossWire plain-text (VPL) edition; words supplied by the translators (printed in italics) are in [square brackets]; pilcrows (¶) kept; Psalm titles are part of verse 1.
